/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program (Delaware, focus_year 2021)

    Note: The provided statutes (29 Del. C.  5706 (2021)) concern Social Security
    coverage plans for political subdivision employees and do not address service of
    process in eviction actions. This program encodes those statutes and the scenario,
    and answers the question by checking whether any encoded statute authorizes
    "posting and mail" as a *secondary* method of service for an eviction action.
*/

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Scenario facts (question statement)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% Jurisdiction/time focus from the question.
scenario_state(delaware).
scenario_focus_year(2021).

% The legal context in the question.
scenario_action(eviction_action).

% Secondary methods of service may be used if primary method is unsuccessful.
scenario_primary_service_unsuccessful(true).

% The method being asked about.
scenario_service_method(posting_and_mail).

% Helper predicate that succeeds when the scenario statement is satisfied.
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(delaware),
    scenario_focus_year(2021),
    scenario_action(eviction_action),
    scenario_primary_service_unsuccessful(true),
    scenario_service_method(posting_and_mail).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Statute encoding: 29 Del. C.  5706 (2021)
%% Plans for coverage of employees of political subdivisions.
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/*
  29 Del. C.  5706(a) (2021):
  - A political subdivision may submit a plan to the State Agency for approval.
  - The State Agency shall approve if it finds the plan conforms to State Agency
    regulations, and no plan shall be approved unless conditions (1)-(6) are met.
*/

% Basic legal roles referenced by the statute.
legal_role(political_subdivision).
legal_role(state_agency).

% Enumerate the mandatory approval conditions in  5706(a)(1)-(6) as atoms.
statute_29de_5706_approval_condition(conformity_social_security_act_and_5703_agreement).    % (a)(1)
statute_29de_5706_approval_condition(covers_all_employment_services_except_218c3b).        % (a)(2)
statute_29de_5706_approval_condition(specifies_adequate_funding_sources).                 % (a)(3)
statute_29de_5706_approval_condition(administration_methods_necessary).                   % (a)(4)
statute_29de_5706_approval_condition(reports_and_compliance_as_required).                 % (a)(5)
statute_29de_5706_approval_condition(authorizes_state_agency_termination_for_noncompliance). % (a)(6)

% A plan is eligible for approval under  5706(a) only if it satisfies all six conditions
% and conforms to State Agency regulations.
%
% We model plan satisfaction via facts:
%   plan_satisfies_condition(Plan, Condition).
%   plan_conforms_to_state_agency_regulations(Plan).
%
% If no such facts exist, this predicate will fail (as it should).
statute_29de_5706_plan_approvable(Plan) :-
    plan_conforms_to_state_agency_regulations(Plan),
    statute_29de_5706_approval_condition(C1),
    statute_29de_5706_approval_condition(C2),
    statute_29de_5706_approval_condition(C3),
    statute_29de_5706_approval_condition(C4),
    statute_29de_5706_approval_condition(C5),
    statute_29de_5706_approval_condition(C6),
    all_distinct_six_conditions(C1, C2, C3, C4, C5, C6),
    plan_satisfies_condition(Plan, C1),
    plan_satisfies_condition(Plan, C2),
    plan_satisfies_condition(Plan, C3),
    plan_satisfies_condition(Plan, C4),
    plan_satisfies_condition(Plan, C5),
    plan_satisfies_condition(Plan, C6).

% Deterministic helper ensuring the six conditions chosen are distinct (avoids accidental
% unification errors if queried in unusual ways).
all_distinct_six_conditions(A, B, C, D, E, F) :-
    A \= B, A \= C, A \= D, A \= E, A \= F,
    B \= C, B \= D, B \= E, B \= F,
    C \= D, C \= E, C \= F,
    D \= E, D \= F,
    E \= F.

%  5706(b): State Agency shall not finally refuse approval or terminate without
% reasonable notice and opportunity for hearing to the political subdivision.
statute_29de_5706_requires_notice_and_hearing_for_refusal_or_termination(StateAgency, PoliticalSubdivision) :-
    legal_role(state_agency),
    legal_role(political_subdivision),
    StateAgency = state_agency,
    PoliticalSubdivision = political_subdivision.

%  5706(c)(1): Each political subdivision with an approved plan shall pay contributions
% into the Contribution Fund with respect to wages, at times prescribed by regulation,
% in amounts/rates specified in the applicable  5703 agreement.
statute_29de_5706_requires_contribution_payments(PoliticalSubdivision, Plan) :-
    approved_plan(PoliticalSubdivision, Plan).

%  5706(c)(2): The political subdivision may impose an employee contribution up to the
% amount of the FICA employee tax that would apply, and may deduct from wages.
% Failure to deduct does not relieve liability.
statute_29de_5706_allows_employee_contribution_withholding(PoliticalSubdivision, Plan) :-
    approved_plan(PoliticalSubdivision, Plan).

statute_29de_5706_failure_to_deduct_does_not_relieve_liability(PoliticalSubdivision, Plan) :-
    approved_plan(PoliticalSubdivision, Plan).

%  5706(d): Delinquent payments may be recovered by court action or deducted from other
% moneys payable to the subdivision at State Agency request; with interest at SSA rate
% but not less than $10 per delinquency.
statute_29de_5706_delinquency_recovery_allowed(PoliticalSubdivision, Plan) :-
    approved_plan(PoliticalSubdivision, Plan).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Service-of-process (eviction) legal query model
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/*
  We answer the question as: "posting and mail" is a permitted secondary method of
  service for an eviction action if and only if some encoded statute expressly
  authorizes it as such in the relevant jurisdiction/time.

  Because the provided statutes do not address eviction service of process, no such
  authorization exists in this knowledge base.
*/

% Primary/secondary service concept from the question.
secondary_method_allowed_only_if_primary_unsuccessful(true).

% A method is "permitted secondary service" only if the law provides it.
permitted_secondary_service(State, Year, Action, Method) :-
    statute_provides_secondary_service(State, Year, Action, Method).

% The provided statutes contain no rules authorizing any eviction service methods.
% This predicate is defined (to avoid "undefined predicate") but has no authorizing facts.
statute_provides_secondary_service(_State, _Year, _Action, _Method) :-
    fail.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Final answer predicate
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_state(State),
    scenario_focus_year(Year),
    scenario_action(Action),
    scenario_service_method(Method),
    scenario_primary_service_unsuccessful(true),
    secondary_method_allowed_only_if_primary_unsuccessful(true),
    permitted_secondary_service(State, Year, Action, Method),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Main entrypoint
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Secondary methods of service are defined as those methods that may be used if the primary method is unsuccessful. Is posting and mail a permitted secondary method of service for an eviction action?
